scope: Symbolic local existence certificate for strict face-halfspace kernel only. No apex coordinate, epsilon, candidate, optimization or cell decomposition generated.
existenceArgument: For any finite direction with dy>0 and dz<0, all six active inequalities become strict for every positive epsilon. Each of the other 32 inequalities is already strict at the reference coordinate, so its affine value remains strict for sufficiently small positive epsilon. Finiteness of the face list supplies a common positive epsilon. Therefore the intersection of the 38 strict face halfspaces is nonempty.
limitations: This certificate is for halfspace visibility only and does not establish native polyMesh topology, overlap-free cone coverage, cell determinant/weight/ratio/skew/nonorthogonality, or halo preservation.
No admissible metric threshold is inferred from the nonempty kernel.
The 28 one-triangle/one-tet determinant upper bounds are only necessary, and 10 literal quadrilateral-base polycells are outside that formula.
All 38 exterior ordered rings, coordinates and physical/source roles remain literal.
